input: grid is a rectangular R by C binary integer matrix; empty/zero-width input is accepted. Padded dimensions/collections fit shared bounds and 4*R*C <= 9007199254740991. All collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse arrays or accessor-backed collections. Node fields, where present, are ordinary data fields. Every individual collection length and computed allocation dimension/count fits [0,4294967295]; explicitly stated padded sizes and heap child-index arithmetic must also fit the declared exact numeric domain. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is permitted. Preconditions are not runtime-checked; allocation/resource capacity and actual completion still require qualification. Python integer inputs are plain int excluding bool; any separately declared floating probabilities are ordinary float.
return: Area of the largest axis-aligned square whose entire boundary consists of ones; interior cells can be zero. Returns zero if no one exists.
mutation_aliasing: No input value or row identity changes; aliased input rows are read-only. Padded prefix arrays are private and no mutable output is returned. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Binary cells make border sum equal to border size exactly when every boundary cell is one. Side-one and side-two squares have no interior; larger squares subtract the inner rectangle. Prefix/query intermediates and side squared are exact under the declared bound. All integer inputs and integer intermediates (apart from opaque Python identity keys) remain in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(R*C*min(R,C) + R + C + 1) worst-case time and O((R+1)*(C+1)) auxiliary space. Sizes are searched largest first, and every candidate border uses at most two O(1) prefix queries. Bounds count ordinary built-in allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop, and stated hash/sort guarantees where relevant.

helpers.name: matrix_prefix
helpers.contract: Creates padded prefix sums with prefix[r][c] equal to the sum of original cells in [0,r) by [0,c). A running row sum combines disjoint regions with the prior-row prefix. Reads but never changes matrix.
helpers.cost: O(R*C+R+C+1) time and O((R+1)*(C+1)) new storage. Full byte-identical helper is separately charged in every client. The complete definition is 423 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines are included in total source bytes.

helpers.name: rectangle_sum
helpers.contract: Returns the sum of a half-open rectangle [top,bottom) by [left,right) from its padded prefix matrix, with in-bounds ordered endpoints. Empty rectangles return zero.
helpers.cost: O(1) time/storage per query. Four prefix terms and each intermediate subtraction/addition are included and constrained by the declared numeric bound. The complete definition is 194 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines are included in total source bytes.
